answer: One concrete defense is a bond-and-quarantine market. Any new agent identity must post a refundable stake before joining the main economy, and begins in the open ocean of unverified actors where it can only take low-value, fully reversible work. Completing verified tasks earns non-transferable reputation that gradually admits it to the haven of high-trust agents handling real funds. Sybil attackers must lock fresh capital for every fake identity and burn time doing cheap work before reaching any nectar worth stealing, so the cost of a thousand bots exceeds the profit of one attack.
